# UI & Design System Quality Checklist: Fundação Visual Consistente

**Purpose**: Validação da qualidade, clareza e completude dos requisitos de design system, tokenização, acessibilidade e migração de interface
**Created**: 2026-08-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness: Tokens e Paleta Neutra

- [ ] CHK001 - Are semantic tokens explicitly defined for all surfaces, borders, text levels, and functional accents in `tokens.css`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the controlled neutral scale quantified with exact hex values for both Light (default) and Dark (prepared) modes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §1]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are typography font stacks, font sizes, font weights, and spacing scales exhaustively documented? [Completeness, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the prohibition of hardcoded colors in `.vue` files accompanied by clear architectural guidelines? [Consistency, Constitution Principle 38]

## Requirement Clarity: Eliminação de Emojis e Padronização de Ícones

- [ ] CHK005 - Is the absolute prohibition of emojis unambiguously specified across all titles, buttons, tabs, badges, and empty states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Constitution Principle 30]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the unified SVG icon strategy (minimalist stroke 1.5px/2px with `currentColor`) explicitly defined as the replacement standard? [Consistency, Clarifications §Session 2026-08-28]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are guidelines for text-only fallbacks established where icons are unnecessary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Visual Hierarchy & Anti-Pattern Prohibition

- [ ] CHK008 - Are requirements clearly defined to prioritize subtle dividers and surface alternation over card containers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Constitution Principle 36]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are prohibitions against gradients, glow/neon, glassmorphism, heavy drop-shadows, and floating cards explicit and testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, Constitution Principle 32]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the restriction of card usage exclusively to atomic, independent units (e.g., task cards) clearly bounded? [Clarity, Constitution Principle 37]

## Component Standardization & Interactive States

- [ ] CHK011 - Are interactive state requirements (`hover`, `focus-visible`, `active`, `disabled`, `loading`, `error`, `empty`) defined for all shared components (`AppButton`, `AppInput`, `AppSelect`, `TimeRangePicker`, `EmptyState`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the visual specification for `focus-visible` (dual ring with contrast against dark/light backgrounds) quantified with exact box-shadow values? [Clarity, Data Model §1]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are props interfaces and event contracts documented for newly introduced components (`AppBadge`, `AppModal`, `AppShell`)? [Traceability, Contracts §2]

## Page Migration & Layout Architecture

- [ ] CHK014 - Are specific migration requirements documented for `/onboarding`, `/today`, `/planning`, and `NotFoundPage.vue`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK015 - Does the spec define the shared layout behavior of `AppShell` across authenticated routes without duplicate headers? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the 404 error page specified with a clear action to return to the active application context? [Coverage, Spec §US3/AC4]

## Accessibility & Responsive Scenarios

- [ ] CHK017 - Are keyboard navigation requirements (Tab order, focus trapping, Escape handling in modals) testable and unambiguous? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are mobile responsiveness requirements quantified for viewports between 320px and 480px without horizontal scroll? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are contrast ratios compliant with WCAG AA thresholds (>4.5:1 for regular text, >3:1 for large text/borders)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013]

## Documentation & Governance Alignment

- [ ] CHK020 - Does the spec define the mandatory contents for `docs/design/FRONTEND_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the boundary excluding runtime theme switchers, backend alterations, and drag-and-drop explicitly documented? [Boundary, Spec §FR-005, §FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001 to CHK021)
